karten.v: What does “group” mean?
karten.r: Parentheses combine part of an expression into a group; a quantifier after the group acts on it as a whole.

karten.v: What does “alternative” mean?
karten.r: The vertical bar forms an alternative: a|b matches where a matches or where b matches.

karten.v: x* means “any number of x, including none”; .* ______ any sequence of characters.
karten.r: x* means “any number of x, including none”; .* matches any sequence of characters.

karten.v: grep -E turns on the ______, in which + ? { } ( ) | are special characters; without -E, they are ordinary characters.
karten.r: grep -E turns on the extended form, in which + ? { } ( ) | are special characters; without -E, they are ordinary characters.

karten.v: + at least once, ? at most once, {n,m} between $n$ and $m$ times; plus the ______ for any number of times.
karten.r: + at least once, ? at most once, {n,m} between $n$ and $m$ times; plus the star for any number of times.

karten.v: (…) turns a part into one unit for ______, a|b offers a choice; the bar binds most weakly.
karten.r: (…) turns a part into one unit for quantifiers, a|b offers a choice; the bar binds most weakly.

karten.v: In the ______, { } and ( ) get a backslash in front, and \+ \? \| are an extra of the GNU tools there; when in doubt, write -E.
karten.r: In the basic form, { } and ( ) get a backslash in front, and \+ \? \| are an extra of the GNU tools there; when in doubt, write -E.

karten.v: The ______ that begins furthest to the left wins, and from there the longest one; you can limit it with a negated bracket expression.
karten.r: The match that begins furthest to the left wins, and from there the longest one; you can limit it with a negated bracket expression.

karten.v: A ______ checks the form of a string, not its meaning; 2026-13-45 has the form of a date.
karten.r: A regular expression checks the form of a string, not its meaning; 2026-13-45 has the form of a date.

karten.v: The ______ evaluates patterns against file names, the program evaluates regular expressions against lines; *, ? and the dot mean different things in the two.
karten.r: The shell evaluates patterns against file names, the program evaluates regular expressions against lines; *, ? and the dot mean different things in the two.

karten.v: What does “sed” mean?
karten.r: The command sed, short for “stream editor”, reads its input line by line.

karten.v: What does “backreference” mean?
karten.r: In the replacement text of s, a backreference \1 to \9 inserts the piece of the first to the ninth group; the opening parentheses are counted from the left.

karten.v: sed applies its ______ to every line of a stream and writes out the result without changing the file.
karten.r: sed applies its commands to every line of a stream and writes out the result without changing the file.

karten.v: s/expression/replacement/ replaces the first ______ per line, with g all of them; & is the match itself.
karten.r: s/expression/replacement/ replaces the first match per line, with g all of them; & is the match itself.

karten.v: A ______ such as 3, $, /expression/ or 2,4 limits a command to certain lines; -n with p outputs only these.
karten.r: A line address such as 3, $, /expression/ or 2,4 limits a command to certain lines; -n with p outputs only these.

karten.v: d drops the selected lines from the ______; 1d removes the header line.
karten.r: d drops the selected lines from the stream; 1d removes the header line.

karten.v: ______ remember their matches, and \1 to \9 insert them again in the replacement text in any order.
karten.r: Groups remember their matches, and \1 to \9 insert them again in the replacement text in any order.

karten.v: sed -i writes the result into a new ______ that replaces the old one; -i.bak keeps the old version. A redirection into the same file, by contrast, empties it.
karten.r: sed -i writes the result into a new file that replaces the old one; -i.bak keeps the old version. A redirection into the same file, by contrast, empties it.

karten.v: What does “awk” mean?
karten.r: The command awk runs a small program that is in its first argument after the options.

karten.v: What does “rules” mean?
karten.r: The program consists of rules of the form condition {action}.

karten.v: What does “associative array” mean?
karten.r: An associative array is a variable in awk that stores any number of values, each under a key of its own: s["Anna"] is the value under the key Anna.

karten.v: An awk program consists of ______ condition {action}, which awk applies to every line.
karten.r: An awk program consists of rules condition {action}, which awk applies to every line.

karten.v: $1 to $NF are the ______ of a line, $0 the whole line, NF their number; -F, splits at commas.
karten.r: $1 to $NF are the fields of a line, $0 the whole line, NF their number; -F, splits at commas.

karten.v: NR is the line number; conditions compare ______ with numbers or text and are combined with &&, || and !.
karten.r: NR is the line number; conditions compare fields with numbers or text and are combined with &&, || and !.

karten.v: awk variables collect values over all lines and ______ at 0; END outputs the result after the last line, printf formats it.
karten.r: awk variables collect values over all lines and start at 0; END outputs the result after the last line, printf formats it.

karten.v: An ______ stores values under keys such as $2; this is how awk collects sums and counters per group in a single pass.
karten.r: An associative array stores values under keys such as $2; this is how awk collects sums and counters per group in a single pass.

karten.v: A ______ grows stage by stage, every intermediate result is checked, and whatever is needed more than once goes into a file.
karten.r: A pipeline grows stage by stage, every intermediate result is checked, and whatever is needed more than once goes into a file.

karten.v: Six small tools in a ______ answer a question for which you would otherwise write a whole program.
karten.r: Six small tools in a pipeline answer a question for which you would otherwise write a whole program.
